q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: SELECT b.name, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker), 0) AS total_num_drinker, COALESCE(AVG(s.price), NULL) AS avg_price, most_frequent.drinker AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b JOIN serves AS s ON s.bar = b.name JOIN frequents AS f ON f.bar = b.name LEFT JOIN (SELECT bar, drinker FROM frequents WHERE (bar, times_a_week) IN (SELECT bar, MAX(times_a_week) FROM frequents GROUP BY bar)) AS most_frequent ON b.name = most_frequent.bar GROUP BY b.name, most_frequent.drinker ORDER BY most_frequent.drinker DESC, b.name
